# Continuous Integration

## Rules
- Track `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; remaining `.github/` agent files, skill copies, `copilot-instructions.md` stay ignored.
- Same job on `macos-latest`, `ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest`; any failure fails check and blocks PR merge. OS-only failures require code fixes under `_global/cross-platform`; MUST NOT exclude runners, skip affected tests, or mask failures with platform-specific workflow steps.
- Trigger: pull requests and pushes to `main`; MUST NOT call Gemini workflows.
- Each job: checkout → pnpm `10.6.5` binary → Node 22 → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Install builds `better-sqlite3`, `@ast-grep/lang-go`, `@ast-grep/lang-php`, `@ast-grep/lang-python`, `esbuild`; no extra apt/brew/Chocolatey packages.
- Checks in order: `pnpm build` → `pnpm typecheck` → `pnpm test`. Build/typecheck exclude `@specd/public-web`.
- `pnpm test`: Vitest for `@specd/core`, `@specd/cli`, `@specd/code-graph`, `@specd/guide`, `@specd/sdk`, `@specd/skills`, `@specd/schema-std`, `@specd/plugin-manager`, `@specd/plugin-agent-claude`, `@specd/plugin-agent-codex`, `@specd/plugin-agent-copilot`, `@specd/plugin-agent-opencode`, `@specd/plugin-agent-standard`. Exclude `@specd/mcp`, `@specd/public-web`.
- MUST NOT run changeset status or publish.

## Constraints
- GitHub Actions workflow; no new test runner.
- Gemini workflow files MAY be tracked within `.github/workflows/`; behavior outside this spec.
